needed.suggestion: Add a pedestrian refuge island at this intersection to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility aids.
Install street lighting along this urban road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
